title: Everyone’s Chasing AI. Start This Simple Business Instead

stated_problem.quote: because normal Airbnb cleaners have no idea how to do it. It's not in their wheelhouse.

claims.quote: And his first month's monthly recurring revenue over $2,000.

claims.claim: Pricing $45-$65 weekly, $199 drain and fill, $100/month plans
claims.quote: $45 to $65 for a weekly chemical balance. $199 for a drain and fill.

within a 25 mile radius, he had over 1,700 different hot tubs that he could service.

claims.claim: Hot tub lets Airbnb charge $40-$100 more/night
claims.quote: are able to charge between $40 and $100 more per night if they have a hot tub.

idea.name: Used hot tub rental business

claims.quote: To buy three used hot tubs for $6,500. He rents them out.

stated_problem.quote: most people have no idea that if you move a hot tub wrong, it can cause thousands of dollars worth of damage. And regular movers refuse to touch these things.

idea.name: Hot tub moving and relocation
idea.one_liner: Specialist hot tub moving for homeowners and for spa retailers who outsource delivery and removal

key_quotes.quote: and then hot tub moving where their customers are spa companies, hot tub companies, retailers that need these things moved.

claims.quote: According to his story, the average hot tub move is $600.
